current_source_and_pipeline.code: Current and 0.2.562 candidate source SHA 417ca980 have no diff in pipeline.ts, to-markdown.ts, MarkdownView.tsx or ScrapeView.tsx. Defuddle supplies article.title and content separately; the extension prepends the title, cleans markdown, and renders it. There is no extension rule that removes the source H1 when article.title equals the document title. In this replay the source H1 is demoted to H2 by Defuddle, but its text survives.

oracle.candidate_562_predicate: tests/browser/store-reviewer-demo-path.mjs at candidate SHA 417ca980: selected Article tab visible and value.text (active Article pane innerText) includes source.schemaHeadline exactly, plus Capture/Understand/Use and no error. oracle.original_failure: Candidate 562 run 39329484777 recorded selected Article=true, content visible=true, stages=true, public_heading_present=false. Thus it failed exact text presence, not heading level or title choice. The title Matrx Extend Demo Page alone cannot satisfy that predicate and cannot explain why the source-headline text was absent.

conclusion: Title substitution/deduplication is not demonstrated as the cause. Current extractor replay preserves both the document-style title and source H1 text in Article markdown. The Store 205 observation alone cannot prove the headline was omitted, and cannot localize the candidate 562 failure. A same-candidate captured SoupResult/articleToMarkdown versus rendered Article text readback remains necessary before any product fix claim.
